    BO13a Lemma 5 a) for a long ρ #

    Reading a crown backwards (Crown.rev) exchanges the roles of the ρ's and the σ's. From lemma5a_mk and lemma5a_last_mk we get: if ρ (t+1) is long, then σ t factors through a first arrow of any contour of ρ (t+1) (MulBasis.lemma5a_rho_first); if ρ t is long, then σ t factors through a last arrow (MulBasis.lemma5a_rho_last).

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.idx_revA (n T : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    2 * n * (2 * (n * (2 * T + 1) - T) + 1 + 1) + 1 - (2 * (n * (2 * T + 1) - T) + 1) = 2 * T + 2 * n * (2 * (n * (2 * T + 1) - T) + 2 - (2 * T + 1))
    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.idx_revB (n T : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    2 * n * (2 * (n * (2 * T + 1) - T) + 1) + 1 - 2 * (n * (2 * T + 1) - T) = 2 * T + 1 + 2 * n * (2 * (n * (2 * T + 1) - T) + 1 - (2 * T + 1))
    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.idx_revC (n t : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    2 * n * (2 * (n * (2 * (t + 1) + 1) - (t + 1) + 1) + 1) + 1 - 2 * (n * (2 * (t + 1) + 1) - (t + 1) + 1) = 2 * t + 1 + 2 * n * (2 * (n * (2 * (t + 1) + 1) - (t + 1)) + 3 - (2 * (t + 1) + 1))
